g.text: III · only when it covers 100% of
the invoice; may fix valor contable
V · the supplier's invoice is crossed
against pending advances in the bag
Every change emails the stakeholders; the workspace projection
refreshes on each transition and is reconciled every 6 h
Approver, Contabilidad and Gerencia can reject (Rechazado);
returns go back one or two steps with a reason
and cuadres as a ledger with LIFO reversal
Annul: the owner of the current phase; once disbursed,
Gerencia or Tesorería, which voids its invoice crosses
